description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of two models, “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)”, across six datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset and Metrics”, displays the categories: eSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC-AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, there are two bars representing the models; “LLaMA-3-8B-it” is represented by blue bars, and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” is represented by orange bars. The “LLaMA-3-8B-it” bars have approximate heights of 73, 65, 62, 60, 52, 48, 45, 38, and 31, corresponding to the datasets listed on the horizontal axis. The “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” bars have approximate heights of 70, 68, 65, 63, 60, 58, 56, 52, and 46, corresponding to the same datasets. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged in the order of the datasets listed on the horizontal axis.
